searchText: Out of curiosity, is any CL client preparing the block for proposals before the start of the slot, optimistically that the head is right? I think we should probably relax and allow to count attestations for the current slot before the slot deadline. Do you see this as a blocker <@520034910149410861>? My intention is to anyway wait until the start of the slot, process any attestation that arrived since the optimistic check and then use the prepared block if head hasn't changed. We already do something along these lines for the honest reorg feature. We check 10 seconds into the slot if our head will change or not. I believe lighthouse does something similar at 11.5 in teku we don't anticipate any processing I'm actually worried by aggressive attestation due reduction, cose we are a bit slow. We would definitely need to do some pre-processing and optimistic thing if time becomes tight Yeah you fetched the right direction of my question. I think it makes sense to request bids for blocks even before the slot starts. On a separate issue <@592004585506340885> I left a comment on 3510 that I think it's relevant. That PR will make testing different slot times harder unless all clients make each individual timing configurable Lodestar PR is already merged, will have a new release in 1-2 weeks On a separate issue @jtraglia I left a Prysm has a PR for this open, not sure if it was merged. I think everyone in the team is fine with it but me. I do not like the switch from opt in to opt out. I would rather wait the community to signal they want it first and then teams adapt the defaults. I think the main thing to avoid is counting in-flight attestations before having attested, e.g. slot N attestations while you're still waiting to attest for slot N. After that (or in epbs after the PTC, if it involves determining the head), I don't see any harm in early counting Thanks, not sure if this should be specified or simply can be taken as an implementation detail since we are anyway determining head again during the next slot. At any rate, I think this will become necessary if we want to decrease slot sizes [Prysm PR](https://github.com/OffchainLabs/prysm/pull/15455) to increase gas limit to 45M has been merged and will be there in the next release
